# Repository ownership safety

- Only create, clone, fork, push to, open pull requests against, or otherwise
  modify repositories owned by `JouniNieminen` or `jnieminen_microsoft`.
- Treat repositories owned by any other user or organization as read-only.
- Before performing a write operation against another owner or organization,
  obtain explicit confirmation from the user naming that owner or organization
  and authorizing the operation.
- A request to "merge", "push", "create a PR", or similar does not by itself
  authorize writing to a repository outside the two approved owners.
- If the current project points to an unapproved owner, stop before any remote
  write, explain the ownership mismatch, and ask which approved repository
  should be used.
